explanation: Logistic Sequence - This is a Machine Learning approach using Logistic Regression trained on sequence features (like streak counts and recent directions) to predict the next move. It operates with signal parameters such as feature_window_set=[5, 10, 20], C=0.5, class_weight=balanced, prediction_threshold=0.6, min_prob_gap=0.08. To control risk, it halts trading after 2 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 6 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 1 units. It avoids trading during highly dominant one-sided market periods (anti-chop mechanism).
